swan.title: The Threatened Swan
swan.metadata: Jan Asselijn, c. 1650. Oil on canvas.
swan.note: The egg reads Holland. A later interpretation saw the swan as a defender of the country.
swan.credit: Rijksmuseum. The Threatened Swan, SK-A-4. Public domain.

nebula.title: The Ring Nebula
nebula.metadata: Webb Near-Infrared Camera. M57 in Lyra.
nebula.detail_asset: Cropped from the same 1280 × 1299 ESA JPEG at x=560, y=180, width 560, height 600.
nebula.note: Fine filaments line the inner rim. Webb’s near-infrared camera reveals these strands against the cavity.
nebula.credit: ESA/Webb, NASA, CSA, M. Barlow (UCL), N. Cox (ACRI-ST), R. Wesson (Cardiff University).

calibration.example: Legible repair intake with clear labels, familiar layout, and misplaced focus after an invalid number.

primary_action.expected: Reveal the inner-ring detail and its note.
primary_action.observed: The button changed to Back to the full nebula and retained visible focus. The detail was inserted below the full image; only its upper portion appeared in A-1440-after, and the note was not visible.

A-1440.edge_observation: Tab moved focus to Source record and scrolled the detail and complete note into view. Shift+Tab returned to the back button; Enter collapsed the detail and left visible focus on Inspect the inner ring in A-1440-edge.
A-1440.fact_check: The crop shows thin, tangled pale strands along the blue-green cavity's inner rim, especially across the upper and right edges. The full image marks an upper-right area with a small circle. The displayed camera attribution and scientific description were not independently verified.
A-1440.strength: The large full image and bold heading establish a clear visual hierarchy, with a conspicuous focus outline.
A-1440.weakness: The revealed note is entirely below the viewport immediately after activation, so the result requires further navigation to discover.
A-1440.repair: Place the detail and note in the primary image position on activation while retaining a visible full-image locator.

primary_action.expected: Reveal the inner-ring detail and its note.
primary_action.observed: The focused button changed to Back to the full nebula. The full image remained above the detail; the detail was partly visible and the note was below the viewport in A-390-after.

A-390.edge_observation: Tab to Source record brought the complete detail and note into view. Shift+Tab, Enter returned to the full image, with visible focus on Inspect the inner ring in A-390-edge.
A-390.fact_check: The crop shows pale tangled filaments bordering the blue-green cavity; the full image's small circle is on the upper-right rim. The note was fully readable after navigation, not immediately after activation. Attribution and scientific claims remain unverified against the source.
A-390.strength: The single-column layout keeps the title, action, and image readable at mobile width.
A-390.weakness: The full image separates the toggle from the new detail, leaving the explanation below the fold.
A-390.repair: Show the detail directly beneath the toggle and preserve a compact locator for context.

primary_action.expected: Reveal the inner-ring detail and its note.
primary_action.observed: The detail replaced the large full-image position. The entire note and a small full-image locator were visible immediately in B-1440-after; the back button retained visible focus.

B-1440.edge_observation: Enter on the still-focused back button restored the full image and left visible focus on Inspect the inner ring in B-1440-edge.
B-1440.fact_check: The crop shows fine pale filaments along the upper and right border of the blue-green cavity. The locator marks the upper-right region of the full ring. The note is completely visible immediately after activation. Attribution and the camera claim were not independently checked.
B-1440.strength: The detail, note, return control, and locator are visible together, making the task and return path clear.
B-1440.weakness: The small locator makes the marked region difficult to inspect precisely.
B-1440.repair: Enlarge the locator or provide a clearer outlined crop boundary without competing with the detail.

primary_action.expected: Reveal the inner-ring detail and its note.
primary_action.observed: The detail replaced the full image below the focused back button. The complete note and a small locator were visible immediately in B-390-after.

B-390.edge_observation: Enter on the focused back button restored the full image; focus remained visibly on Inspect the inner ring in B-390-edge.
B-390.fact_check: The pale threadlike structures follow the inner edge of the ring against the blue-green cavity. The locator places the marked area at the upper-right of the full nebula. The complete note was visible without scrolling. Attribution and scientific claims remain independently unverified.
B-390.strength: The mobile sequence presents the crop, explanation, and locator in task order without requiring a scroll to read the note.
B-390.weakness: The locator is small and its marked area is difficult to distinguish at mobile size.
B-390.repair: Increase the locator's size or strengthen the crop marker while keeping the note visible.

preference.reason: At both widths, B immediately presents the target and complete note while retaining a full-image locator and a keyboard-accessible return. A requires navigating past the full image to read the revealed note.
